sourceLicense.notice: Normalized static facts extracted from AGPL-marked source; no separate permissive data license is asserted. No upstream function bodies are copied, imported, evaluated, transpiled or executed.

metadata.opcodeOrder: Execute operations in source order; if/switch are structured control flow. Do not collect all forms/moves/abilities into unordered patches.

getRandomPartyMemberFunc.pool: Nested pools preserve grouping; seeded selection repeats until numeric species. Evolution/level/strength are runtime generation, not callback execution.

getRandomRivalPartyMemberFunc.semantics: Reads pool/postProcess/balance flags from config[slot]. Type/weakness balancing and seeded continuity generation are not executed here.

replaceMove.semantics: Replace an existing target move unless the replacement is already present; respects moveset-randomizer challenge.

ensureMove.semantics: Insert replacement at preferredSlot only if neither exact move nor acceptableAlternative predicate exists; respects moveset-randomizer challenge.

randSeedInt.bounds: min through min+range-1 inclusive; deferred, no RNG drawn

randSeedIntRange.bounds: inclusive min and max; deferred, no RNG drawn

randSeedItem.semantics: Seeded choice is deferred; literal candidate alternatives are retained

fieldSemantics.slot: Literal source slot; negative slots count from party end. Source helper generation is not invoked.
fieldSemantics.abilityIndex: Source Pokemon form ability slot index; this is not an AbilityId. Resolve against selected source form after earlier operations.
fieldSemantics.formIndex: Source species form array index, not PokeAPI form ID.
fieldSemantics.enumValues: Numeric values are pinned source IDs. usedEnumSymbols preserves original enum names.
fieldSemantics.sourceArguments: Literal/normalized AST argument facts. Runtime/external references are explicit markers.
fieldSemantics.gym: All74 gyms have zero direct setPartyMemberFunc overrides. Their signature setup is inherited and recorded separately.
fieldSemantics.finalMoves: generateMoveset is deferred. The data specifies ordered corrections/ensures/replacements, not a pre-generated final team or final moveset.
fieldSemantics.callRule: Declarative call to rival.functions[name], binding recorded parameters/defaults. This extractor does not execute it. return exits the current rule; break exits the current switch; let creates a scoped runtime value.
fieldSemantics.rivalStarter: Fights5/6 call forceRivalStarterTraits with bars2/3 and useRivalSignature=true. These postprocessors do not explicitly force a starter form. Signature moveset generation is a separate runtime helper contract.

limitations: 332 inline trainer postprocessors plus6 named rival functions and15 inline rival rules are normalized. Runtime generation and inherited Proxy fallbacks are not executed.

setGenModifiersFunc, random Tera modifier factories, trainer AI and held-item runtime functions are not evaluated or included as member callbacks. Rival related trainer-level omitted callbacks have explicit source locations.
No per-member level write appears in the332 trainer-config callbacks; rival fixed level writes are recorded separately, without applying any project level cap.
Static coverage is not runtime gameplay implementation coverage.

Blue Mega Pidgeot/Hurricane, Leon G-Max Charizard and Mustard eight conditional move writes checked
All26 rival factories linked to6 fights and named/inline postprocessors
Final Mega Rayquaza form1/level200/unspecified generated segments and fight5 level129 defaults checked
